name: alert
title: Alert
description: Displays a callout for user attention.

docs.lead: Displays a callout for user attention.
docs.usage:
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert'

<Alert>
  <AlertTitle>Heads up!</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>
    You can add components to your app using the cli.
  </AlertDescription>
</Alert>

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style of the alert (e.g., warningLighter, infoPrimaryFilled, infoPrimaryLight, infoPrimaryLighter, infoDarkFilled)

props.name: dismissButton
props.description: Whether to show a dismiss button

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Callback when dismiss button is clicked
